about: Spell-preview visual effects of the spell being targeted: an object stored behind a pointer (creator bg3.exe+0x1EEA9E0, called from the spell preview update bg3.exe+0x1ED9230) that holds a small chained hash map and two effect-handler sub-objects, each carrying an ecl::EffectHandlerInitInfo. Born live in a targeting step together with ForceComponent, HighlightsComponent, SurfaceTilesComponent and spell_cast::TargetingComponent. Partial layout: mostly unknown members.

survey.base: none known in Script Extender; the component storage holds an 8-byte pointer to this object (creator bg3.exe+0x1EEA9E0 registers element size 8 and stores the pointer of a 0x2F8-byte allocation).
open_questions: Identity of the 0x130-byte sub-object class (FUN_141c73c90) and its members.
Key/value types of the chained map at +0 and of the HashSet-shaped block at +0x2B0.
Element type of the array at +0x280.
Whether the live sample reads the object itself (it matches the creator's stores, so it seems so).

+0x290..+0x29B is not written by the creator (bg3.exe+0x1EEA9E0 writes +0x280/+0x288/+0x28C, then +0x29C) and one live sample holds a heap pointer there, so glm::vec3 is doubtful; no reader was found (no bg3.exe pseudo-code near the spell-preview functions uses +0x290).

The block +0x2A8..+0x2DF: the creator stores qword +0x2A8, dword +0x2B0, qwords +0x2B8/+0x2C0/+0x2C8, dword +0x2CC, +0x2D0 (taken by address), qword +0x2D8, dword +0x2DC - not a clean HashSet constructor starting at +0x2B0 as the first version said.
survey.second_pass: Not settled: only the creator bg3.exe+0x1EEA9E0 was re-read; its stores contradict the HashSet-at-+0x2B0 reading and do not cover +0x290, whose live values are not always floats. The two 0x130-byte sub-objects (FUN_141C73C90) and the map at +0 still need their own classes identified.
